summary: In Seattle, WA, Geothermal Heat Pump Case Study: Seattle Public Schools is an implementation initiative. The program uses geo-thermal heat pumps and electric boilers. The case addresses extreme Heat and Public Health. Available materials report all schools involved in project have replaced gas-fired boilers with geothermal heat pumps and electric boilers. Seattle Public Schools’ electrical supply is 91% renewable, and carbon credits offset the remaining 9%, and operational greenhouse gas emissions are minimal.
title: Geothermal Heat Pump Case Study: Seattle Public Schools
